text:
jen: Heads up — staging canary failed to promote. prepare-release step errors out with git refs lock (exit 128). blocking release window.
jen: logs show: 
```
Cloning into 'repo'...
fatal: Unable to create '/srv/git/repo/.git/refs/heads/release-2026-03.lock': File exists.
fatal: cannot write refs/heads/release-2026-03
```
deploy-bot: CI https://ci.internal/runs/9999 failed: prepare-release (exit 128)
alex: sounds like concurrent runs writing the same ref. last time this happened it was a stale .lock from a stuck pipeline.
sam: ops-bot, can you list locks and owning pipeline?
ops-bot: repo-locker: locks = [refs/heads/release-2026-03 -> pipeline/4778899000 (age=6m)]
maria: is pipeline/4778899000 still running?
jen: controller says it's "finishing" and can't be cancelled. tried cancel twice.
alex: if it's stuck finishing it may never clean up lock. We need a safe unblock that doesn't rm locks blindly. Options: cancel + wait, manual rm after verifying process killed, or bypass prepare-release by pinning artifact to last-known-good.
sam: PM warns change window closes in ~40m. pinning is fastest to unblock. We'll add a tiny CHANGELOG entry explaining the emergency pin.
maria: agree. pin + manual promote, run smoke tests, follow up with RCA.
jen: last-green artifact: build/5421 sha256:abcd1234.
sam: opening PR to pin image hash and add changelog. PR: https://git.internal/org/release/pulls/1299 — title: "pin release to last-green to avoid subtree lock".
maria: LGTM, approving now.
ops-bot: scheduled manual_promote job 4781230400 (requested by sam) — will skip prepare-release split but run smoke-test-suite.
deploy-bot: manual promote will skip subtree split step and proceed to deploy + smoke tests.
alex: follow-up action: I'll open task to make prepare-release use per-run namespaced refs (assign alex). also add guard so only one split for a given ref may run concurrently.
maria: creating INC-2026-33 to track the incident and RCA.
jen: action summary: sam -> PR and trigger promote (done), maria -> approve & monitor (done), alex -> follow-up task for ref namespacing, ops -> confirm no orphan locks after promote.
sam: after promote, let's run a cleanup pipeline to ensure no leftover .lock files.
alex: also add CI check to prevent overlapping split runs for same release ref.
maria: thanks everyone. keep this thread open until the promote + smoke completes. :thumbsup:
